features.text: GE® 36 in. 27.0 Cu. Ft. Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel French Door Refrigerator - GNE27JYMFS
Easily store large or bulk food items with three full-width shelves and large capacity
Internal water dispenser delivers filtered water with one touch
A variety of shelf configurations provide additional options for food storage
Find exactly what you’ve been looking for under crisp, clear LED lighting
GE® 24" Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel Top Control Built In Dishwasher - GDT650SYVFS
Dry Boost™ Technology outperforms standard heated-dry dishwashers by getting hard-to-dry items like plastics up to 3 times drier
The versatile third rack was redesigned to load more than just silverware with additional space for unique items.
Save time with a high-temperature cycle that steams and sanitizes.
This dishwasher features Active Flood Protect, which prevents potential overflows for greater peace of mind.
GE® 30'' Stainless Steel Freestanding Gas Range - GGF600AVSS
Cook and brown foods more evenly with convection cooking that uses a rear fan to circulate hot air.
A large cooking surface gives you extra room for pots and pans of all sizes and lets cookware move easily from burner to burner.
This model features a removable oven storage drawer that offers the perfect place to store cookware and other kitchen accessories.
Cook an entire meal at once with room to spare in this oven with 5.3 cubic foot capacity.
GE® 1.6 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Over The Range Microwave - JVM3160RFSS
Charcoal filter replacement for microwaves with behind the door grille
1000 Watts (IEC-705 test procedure)
Defrosting times and power levels are programmed automatically or manually for optimal results
Two-speed, 300-CFM venting system
